akinkunmi-2026.method: Review of mitochondrial function in health and disease

mustakim-2024.source: Mustakim, Eo & Kim (2024) J Korean Assoc Oral Maxillofac Surg 50(4):177–188

detail.en: The ER is crucial for protein synthesis, transport and folding, as well as calcium storage, lipid and steroid synthesis, and carbohydrate metabolism

mustakim-2024.method: Systematic review of ER stress (MEDLINE); first sentence of abstract used for ER function

detail.en: The Golgi is the central component of the mammalian secretory pathway: it processes protein and lipid cargo and sorts proteins and lipids at the trans-Golgi network to their destinations, shaping plasma membrane composition
detail.zh-Hant: 高爾基體是哺乳類分泌途徑的核心：加工蛋白質和脂質貨物，並在反面高爾基網絡把蛋白質和脂質分選至目的地，從而塑造質膜組成

agliarulo-2022.method: Review of Golgi functions in the mammalian secretory pathway

detail.en: Peroxisomes are single-membrane organelles that produce and break down hydrogen peroxide, oxidize fatty acids that mitochondria cannot catabolize, and synthesize ether lipids and bile acids
detail.zh-Hant: 過氧化物酶體是單層膜細胞器，負責產生和分解過氧化氫，氧化粒線體無法分解的脂肪酸，並合成醚脂和膽汁酸

kleiboeker-2022.method: Review of peroxisomal roles in energy metabolism

ferrari-2024.source: Ferrari et al. (2024) Cell Mol Biol Lett 29(1):116

detail.en: Lysosomes are acidic organelles that degrade proteins and organelles and take part in membrane repair, phagocytosis, endocytosis and nutrient sensing
detail.zh-Hant: 溶酶體是酸性細胞器，降解蛋白質和細胞器，並參與膜修復、吞噬作用、內吞作用和營養感應

scott-2014.source: Scott, Vacca & Gruenberg (2014) Semin Cell Dev Biol 31:2–10

detail.en: Early and late endosomes are the two main sorting stations of the endocytic pathway: the early endosome routes cargo to recycling endosomes, the trans-Golgi network or late endosomes, and the late endosome is a hub toward lysosomes, Golgi or plasma membrane and a nutrient-sensing platform
detail.zh-Hant: 早期和晚期內體是內吞途徑的兩個主要分選站：早期內體把貨物送往回收內體、反面高爾基網絡或晚期內體；晚期內體是通往溶酶體、高爾基體或質膜的樞紐，亦是營養感應平台

scott-2014.method: Review of endosome maturation and functions

detail.en: The sarcoplasmic reticulum is a network of tubules and cisternae that regulates calcium homeostasis during muscle contraction, storing and releasing calcium for excitation-contraction coupling and taking it back up
detail.zh-Hant: 肌漿網是由小管和池組成的網絡，在肌肉收縮時調節鈣平衡，負責儲存、釋放和回收鈣，以進行興奮收縮偶聯

rossi-2022.method: Review of skeletal muscle sarcoplasmic reticulum

detail.en: Myofibrils are striated muscle organelles made of sarcomeres, the smallest functional contractile unit of muscle, aligned in series
detail.zh-Hant: 肌原纖維是橫紋肌的細胞器，由串聯排列的肌節組成，肌節是肌肉最小的功能收縮單位

herzog-2022.method: Review of single sarcomere and myofibril preparations

johnson-2025.source: Johnson (2025) Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol 26(9):667–690

johnson-2025.method: Review of the photosynthetic electron transport chain (angiosperm focus)

detail.en: The vacuole maintains cell acidity and turgor pressure, regulates storage and transport of substances, and responds to biotic and abiotic stress
